_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Description profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifDataDescription/schema.yaml. Diagram scope: only the data-description-specific content. Anchor classes Dataset / CatalogRecord / DataDownload / WebAPI / ActionResult are restated as minimal stubs (full definitions in CDIFCore). cdifCore is NOT composed so the overview stays tight; cross-profile registry handles the stub <-> CDIFCore links. The discovery-level properties (measurementTechnique / spatialCoverage / temporalCoverage / hasQualityMeasurement) belong to cdifDiscovery and are NOT modelled here. The schema permits cdif:hasPhysicalMapping items to be PhysicalMapping or its subtypes TextMapping / LocatorMapping; rendered here as an abstract AbstractMapping with three concrete subtypes. Similarly, a DataDownload may be co-typed with cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet (an abstract AbstractDataSet wraps the two physical-dataset variants).

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Description Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Description Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Variable-level physical data types, primary keys, statistics, physical mappings on distributions
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Description profile module. On any Dataset whose catalog record declares conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0, this profile adds: (a) cdif:hasPrimaryKey on the Dataset, (b) cdif:statistics on the Dataset, (c) richer InstanceVariable shape (cdif:physicalDataType required, plus optional cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom / cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom value-domains), and (d) physical mapping on schema:distribution items - cdif:hasPhysicalMapping (any of PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping) on DataDownload and on WebAPI's potentialAction.result, plus cdi:characterSet and cdi:fingerprint (DataFingerprint). A DataDownload MAY be co-typed cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data Description profile additions: variable-level physical types, primary keys, statistics, distribution-level physical mappings.

package.name: Variables
package.definition: Variable description: cdi:InstanceVariable with its physical data type and value domains.

package.name: Distribution
package.definition: Distribution-level additions: physical mapping family (AbstractMapping with PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping subtypes), physical dataset family (AbstractDataSet with TabularTextDataSet / StructuredDataSet subtypes), and the DataFingerprint datatype.

package.name: Statistics
package.definition: cdif:statistics: Statistic / Statistics / StatisticsCollection / CategoryStatistics / Category.

package.name: ValueDomains
package.definition: SubstantiveValueDomain and SentinelValueDomain (referenced from InstanceVariable's takesSubstantiveValuesFrom / takesSentinelValuesFrom).

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes the profile attaches to (Dataset / CatalogRecord / DataDownload / WebAPI / ActionResult). Full definitions live in CDIFCore; these stubs let the diagram render attachment edges without dragging the entire CDIFCore graph in.

class._comment: Dataset stub - the host node carrying cdif:hasPrimaryKey, cdif:statistics, schema:variableMeasured, schema:distribution, and the schema:subjectOf back-reference to CatalogRecord.
class.definition: Stub of schema:Dataset (full definition in CDIFCore). Re-declared so the diagram can render the data-description-specific edges.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the dataset.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - carries the required https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0 conformance declaration.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For the data-description profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0 for the data-description profile.

class._comment: DataDownload stub - a downloadable distribution. cdif:hasPhysicalMapping (to AbstractMapping items), cdi:characterSet, cdi:fingerprint (DataFingerprint), and the cdi: physical-dataset co-typing (TabularTextDataSet / StructuredDataSet) attach here. Full definition in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DataDownload. Carries data-description additions: cdif:hasPhysicalMapping, cdi:characterSet, cdi:fingerprint, and optional co-typing as cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet (AbstractDataSet specializations).

attribute.name: characterSet
attribute.definition: cdi:characterSet - the character set used in the distribution (e.g. UTF-8, ASCII).

class._comment: WebAPI stub - a WebAPI distribution. cdif:hasPhysicalMapping attaches to its potentialAction.result, not directly to the WebAPI. Modelled as WebAPI -> ActionResult -> AbstractMapping[].
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::WebAPI. Carries a potentialAction whose result has cdif:hasPhysicalMapping + cdi:characterSet at the data-description level.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the WebAPI distribution.

class._comment: ActionResult stub - the response from a WebAPI's potentialAction. Carries the same data-description payload (cdif:hasPhysicalMapping, cdi:characterSet) as a DataDownload, because the response is another physical realization of the dataset's variables.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::ActionResult (schema.org Action's schema:result). For data description, carries cdif:hasPhysicalMapping (to AbstractMapping) and cdi:characterSet.

attribute.name: characterSet
attribute.definition: cdi:characterSet - the character set used in the API response.

class._comment: InstanceVariable - the cdi:InstanceVariable shape contributed by cdifDataDescription. cdif:physicalDataType is required at this profile level. Substantive/sentinel value domains attach here directly (in DataStructure profiles, they move to RepresentedVariable instead). 'new' mapping (not 'map') because we are restating the attributes explicitly for this profile rather than auto-importing the DDI-CDI superset.
class.definition: A cdi:InstanceVariable as referenced by schema:variableMeasured. At Data Description level, every InstanceVariable must have an @id and a cdif:physicalDataType so physical mappings can reference it.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for this variable; target of cdif:formats_InstanceVariable references from physical mappings.

attribute.name: physicalDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:physicalDataType - the physical representation type (string, decimal, integer, dateTime, ...). Required at Data Description level.

class._comment: AbstractMapping - abstract supertype for the three concrete mapping shapes. The cdif:hasPhysicalMapping property on DataDownload / WebAPI.result accepts any of the three. cdif:formats_InstanceVariable is modelled as an association to InstanceVariable (see Associations) rather than an attribute, since underscores aren't allowed in UML attribute names.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for the cdif:hasPhysicalMapping family. Each concrete subtype maps a variable to a specific physical representation: PhysicalMapping (generic index-based), TextMapping (delimited / fixed-width text), LocatorMapping (locator string for structured data). Every concrete mapping carries a cdif:formats_InstanceVariable reference to the variable it describes.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - optional resolvable URI for this mapping (mappings are usually inline value objects but may be referenced when shared).

class._comment: PhysicalMapping - generic per-field physical mapping. Concrete subtype of AbstractMapping.
class.definition: Generic per-field physical mapping. Carries column index, format, physical data type, null sequence, etc., for a variable's representation in a file.

attribute.name: index
attribute.definition: cdif:index - column index (zero-based) of this variable's values in the file.

attribute.name: format
attribute.definition: cdif:format - format token / pattern for parsing values (e.g. ISO8601, decimal, ...).

attribute.name: physicalDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:physicalDataType - physical representation type for this column's bytes.

class._comment: TextMapping - per-field physical mapping with delimited / fixed-width text-specific attributes (column width, number-formatting detail).
class.definition: Per-field mapping specialized for delimited or fixed-width text data sets. Extends PhysicalMapping with column-width and number-format-detail attributes.

attribute.name: index
attribute.definition: cdif:index - column index of this variable in the text data set.

class._comment: LocatorMapping - locates a variable's values within a structured (hierarchical) dataset via a locator expression (XPath / JSONPath).
class.definition: Per-field mapping for structured (hierarchical) data sets. Uses a locator expression (XPath / JSONPath) instead of a column index.

attribute.name: locator
attribute.definition: cdi:locator - locator expression (e.g. JSONPath) to extract this variable's values from the structured dataset.

class._comment: AbstractDataSet - abstract supertype for the cdi:PhysicalDataSet co-types a schema:DataDownload may carry. The schema lets a DataDownload also be typed cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet to mark its on-disk shape.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for the cdi:PhysicalDataSet co-types a DataDownload may declare: TabularTextDataSet (delimited / fixed-width text) or StructuredDataSet (XML / JSON / hierarchical).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - same @id as the underlying DataDownload (this is a co-typing, not a separate object).

class._comment: TabularTextDataSet - DataDownload co-typed as cdi:TabularTextDataSet. Carries the delimited/fixed-width layout attributes (delimiter, hasHeader, ...).
class.definition: DataDownload co-typed as cdi:TabularTextDataSet: delimited or fixed-width text data set (CSV / TSV / fixed). Carries CSV-style layout attributes; per-field mappings are TextMapping (via cdif:hasPhysicalMapping).

attribute.name: delimiter
attribute.definition: csvw:delimiter - field-separator character.

attribute.name: header
attribute.definition: csvw:header - whether the first row(s) are headers.

class._comment: StructuredDataSet - DataDownload co-typed as cdi:StructuredDataSet for hierarchical/structured serializations (XML / JSON). Per-field mappings are LocatorMapping.
class.definition: DataDownload co-typed as cdi:StructuredDataSet: hierarchical / structured data set (XML, JSON, ...). Per-field mappings are LocatorMapping (XPath / JSONPath).

attribute.name: encoding
attribute.definition: Encoding-family hint (e.g. XML, JSON) for the structured dataset.

class._comment: DataFingerprint - integrity fingerprint (checksum / hash) of a distribution's bytes. DDI-CDI DataFingerprint datatype.
class.definition: Integrity fingerprint (checksum / hash) of a distribution's bytes. DDI-CDI DataFingerprint datatype; carried inline on a DataDownload via cdi:fingerprint.

attribute.name: algorithm
attribute.definition: Hash algorithm identifier.

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: Hash digest value as a hex string.

class._comment: PrimaryKey - cdif:hasPrimaryKey on the Dataset: a cdif:Key whose isComposedOf is an ordered list of InstanceVariables that uniquely identify a row.
class.definition: Primary key of the dataset: a cdif:Key whose cdif:isComposedOf is an ordered list of cdi:InstanceVariables uniquely identifying each data instance.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the key (so it can be referenced from elsewhere).

class._comment: Statistics - bundle of one or more Statistic values for the dataset's variables. Target of cdif:statistics.
class.definition: A named bundle of one or more Statistic value objects for an instance variable, optionally weighted, optionally broken down by Category.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this statistics bundle.

class._comment: SubstantiveValueDomain - the set of valid, meaningful values for a variable. At Data Description level it attaches directly to InstanceVariable; in DataStructure profiles it moves to RepresentedVariable.
class.definition: The substantive value domain for a variable - the set of valid, meaningful values (cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the value domain.

class._comment: SentinelValueDomain - missing / not-applicable value codes for a variable (cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom).
class.definition: Sentinel (missing / not-applicable) value domain for a variable. Attaches to InstanceVariable at Data Description level; moves to RepresentedVariable in DataStructure profiles.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the value domain.

association._comment: Dataset -> CatalogRecord via schema:subjectOf (attachment point for the cdif:data_description/1.0 conformance declaration).
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata. MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0.

association._comment: Dataset -> InstanceVariable via schema:variableMeasured. Required (the array must be non-empty).
association.definition: schema:variableMeasured - the variables described by this dataset. Required.
cdif:hasPrimaryKey - the primary key of the dataset.
cdif:statistics - summary statistics describing the dataset's values.

association._comment: Dataset -> DataDownload via schema:distribution (when distribution item is a DataDownload).
association.definition: schema:distribution - a downloadable distribution. May be co-typed cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet (see AbstractDataSet subtypes).

association._comment: Dataset -> WebAPI via schema:distribution (when distribution item is a WebAPI).
association.definition: schema:distribution - a WebAPI distribution. Per-field mappings attach to the WebAPI's potentialAction.result (see ActionResult).

association._comment: DataDownload -> AbstractMapping via cdif:hasPhysicalMapping. The schema admits any of PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping; the abstract class anchors the diagram.
association.definition: cdif:hasPhysicalMapping - per-field physical mappings linking variables to their on-disk representation. Each item is one of PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping.

association._comment: DataDownload -> AbstractDataSet via the cdi: physical-dataset co-typing (TabularTextDataSet or StructuredDataSet).
association.definition: Co-typing: a DataDownload MAY also be typed cdi:TabularTextDataSet (delimited / fixed-width) or cdi:StructuredDataSet (XML / JSON). Represented in JSON-LD as an additional @type value (shared @id with the DataDownload), not a separate object.
cdi:fingerprint - integrity fingerprint of this distribution's bytes.

association._comment: WebAPI -> ActionResult via schema:potentialAction.result. The schema nests this two deep; the diagram collapses to the direct relationship.
association.definition: schema:potentialAction.schema:result - the response object of the WebAPI's main action. Carries cdif:hasPhysicalMapping + cdi:characterSet at this profile level.

association._comment: ActionResult -> AbstractMapping via cdif:hasPhysicalMapping. Same shape as the DataDownload edge.
association.definition: cdif:hasPhysicalMapping - per-field physical mappings for the API response (which is another physical realization of the dataset's variables).

association._comment: AbstractMapping -> InstanceVariable via cdif:formats. Inherited by all three subtypes. (Association name uses 'formats' rather than 'formats_InstanceVariable' to fit the targetAssociationName regex; the actual JSON-LD property is cdif:formats_InstanceVariable per the schema.)
association.definition: cdif:formats_InstanceVariable - the InstanceVariable this mapping describes (by @id reference).
cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom - the substantive value domain for this variable.
cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom - sentinel (missing / NA) value domain(s) for this variable.
